cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with major depressive disorder. Initial presentation: I was worried about my husband's depression and he had the idea of ​​committing suicide..

turns.message: I was worried about my husband's depression and he had the idea of ​​committing suicide.
He always has insomnia, back pain, and doesn't want to eat. To be honest, I was a little overwhelmed.
The doctor advised him to take a break and have a psychological counseling, but it has not started yet.
How can I help him?
I tried my best, but his emotions affected our relationship.
How to do it specifically?
How should I support him at home?
I understand, is there any other way?
I will work hard with him.
We are willing to try.
I have hope for this.
Thank you, I feel a little relieved.

I just found out my doctor is recommending ECT, and I don't know how to feel about it. Part of me is terrified—I've heard things about memory loss, and the idea of being put under anesthesia scares me. But another part of me is so exhausted from fighting my depression that I just want relief, no matter what it takes. I feel so overwhelmed, like I'm drowning in all these conflicting emotions.

I think what scares me the most is the unknown—what if it doesn’t work? What if it changes me in ways I can’t predict? I already feel so lost, like I’m not even myself anymore. And then there’s this deeper fear... like what if nothing ever helps? I’m sick of feeling this way, sick of everything. It’s like I’m stuck in this dark place with no way out.

I don’t even know what ‘feeling like myself’ means anymore. It’s been so long since I felt okay. Sometimes I wonder if anyone really understands how alone this feels. Like I’m the only one who can’t figure out how to live with this. I just want to know that there’s a chance things could get better, that I won’t always feel this broken.

I’ve been feeling so heavy lately, like I’m carrying this weight that just won’t go away. The anxiety is constant, and the depression makes it hard to even get out of bed some days. What makes it worse is that my family never really understood or supported me when I tried to talk about it. They’d just tell me to 'snap out of it' or that I was being dramatic. It’s like I’ve been dealing with this alone for years.

Yeah, I guess it’s like... the only time I feel anything close to okay is when I’m doing extreme sports, like rock climbing or skydiving. It’s like the adrenaline drowns out everything else. But afterward, the crash is even worse. I don’t know why I keep chasing that high when it doesn’t really fix anything.

I just can't believe she's gone. One day she was here, and the next... I feel so angry—at her, at myself, at everything. And then the guilt hits me because how can I be angry at her when she was in so much pain? I'm drowning in this mess of emotions, and on top of it all, my own depression feels heavier than ever. I don't know how to keep going like this.

It's not just about her... it's like her death made me question everything. What's the point of any of this? I keep thinking, 'Why bother getting a job or going back to school?' It all feels meaningless. I wake up with this weight of doom, like nothing I do matters. And then I just... avoid everything. I don't even want to leave my bed.

I don't know if anything feels meaningful anymore. Sometimes I wonder if I even deserve to find meaning. I feel so worthless, like I'm just... existing. And then I think about her and how she must have felt, and it terrifies me. I don't want to end up like that, but I don't know how to climb out of this hole.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with psychosis. Initial presentation: Psychological counselor, hello, I have been in some trouble recently, and I am very troubled..

turns.message: Psychological counselor, hello, I have been in some trouble recently, and I am very troubled.
I found that my relationship with my mom was getting more and more tense, and she was always over-interfering in my life, and I felt very uncomfortable.

OK When I was a child, I was mainly taken care of by my grandparents in the countryside. My parents left me to work in other places when I was very young. After entering junior high school, I returned to my parents, but I felt that our relationship was always very distant.

She always tells me what to do and what not to do. For example, if I want to try something new, she always says I can't do it, for fear that I will mess it up. She also restricted my interpersonal relationships, which made me feel very depressed.
I feel that my self-confidence has been greatly affected, and I have also become disgusted with learning and do not want to interact with others. I think I'm useless.
OK, I'd like to give it a try. However, I don't know how to start.
OK, I'll give it a try. But I was still a little worried, afraid that she would not understand.
Well, I will work hard. Thank you psychological counselor, I believe that with your help, I will get better and better.
Psychological counselor, hello, I am a high school student, I have encountered some trouble recently, and I am very troubled.
Recently, some classmates have always teased me and even violated my privacy. I tried to resist, but the situation is getting worse and I am now scared to go to school.
I told my parents and teachers, but they said it was just a joke between the kids and made me more generous. I felt helpless and I didn't know what to do.
I felt hurt and I wanted them to stop this behavior, but I didn't know how to express it. I'm afraid that expressing my needs will make things worse.
My parents were very busy when I was a kid and they rarely stayed with me. I am mainly cared for by my grandparents and spend very little time with them.
Thank you, psychological counselor. I know the process may not be easy, but I am willing to try it and hope to get rid of the current troubles.
OK, I will try to relax and open myself to you.
Psychological counselor, hello, I have had some conflicts with my husband recently, and I am very troubled. I hope you can help me.
I feel like my husband is a little "mama's baby". He always listens to his mother. Even if I know that his mother's opinion is not always right, he will not refute it.
Yes, I feel very frustrated. Recently, his mother asked him to go on a blind date, but he actually agreed and didn't consider my feelings at all.
I'm not sure, he always says he listens to his mother because of respect, but I feel he's a little overly dependent.
I tried it, but he always said his mom's opinion was important and I felt I couldn't change him.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with self-harm. Initial presentation: I just feel so exhausted and defeated.

turns.message: I just feel so exhausted and defeated. No matter how hard I try, nothing ever seems to work out the way I want. I put in so much effort—staying late at work, helping my family, always trying to be there for others—but it’s like I’m invisible. I hate myself for never being enough. What’s the point anymore?

It’s like... no matter what I do, I’m always falling short. My siblings are all successful—great careers, families, everyone praises them—and here I am, just... stuck. I try so hard to make people happy, to prove I’m worth something, but it’s never good enough. Sometimes I wonder if they’d even notice if I just disappeared.

I don’t even know how to do that. It feels selfish, and honestly, I’m not sure I deserve it. But... I’m so tired of feeling this way. Like I’m just a shadow in my own life. Maybe I don’t want to disappear—maybe I just want to feel real, like I’m allowed to take up space.

I just feel so... worthless. Like no matter what I do, it's never enough. I'm exhausted from trying so hard and still feeling like a failure. I can't even look at myself in the mirror without feeling disgusted. What's the point of all this?

I think it goes back to always feeling like I had to earn love. My parents were so critical, and now I hear their voices in my head calling me lazy or selfish. Even when people say kind things, I don't believe them. It's like I'm waiting for the other shoe to drop—for everyone to realize I'm unlovable.
Sometimes I wonder if God or the universe just... made a mistake with me. Like I'm fundamentally broken. But the idea of being kind to myself almost scares me—what if I'm just excusing my flaws?

I just feel like such a failure. No matter what I do, it's never enough. I'm exhausted from trying, and honestly, I don't even see the point anymore. The thought of ending it all keeps creeping in because I can't stand feeling this worthless.

I guess it's always been this way—like I’m chasing approval from people who never really see me. My parents, my ex... it’s like I’m screaming into a void. And when they leave or criticize me, it just confirms what I already believe: that I’m unlovable. I’m so tired of being abandoned.
I’ve never thought of it like that... but it’s hard to imagine ever feeling worthy. Like, what if I’m just broken?

I just feel so... worthless. Like no matter what I do, it's never enough. I can't even look at myself in the mirror without feeling disgusted. The only thing that numbs the pain is cutting, but then I hate myself even more for doing it. I push everyone away because I don't want them to see how broken I am inside.

It's just... every time I try to hope things will get better, something happens that proves I'm unfixable. Like I'm destined to keep failing. Why bother trying to connect with people when I'll just disappoint them? Even basic things like showering or eating feel impossible most days. I don't deserve care.

I'm scared that... even if I try, there's no point. What if I'm always this empty? What if the only thing waiting for me is more pain? Sometimes I wonder why I'm even here. But... part of me is still so tired of hurting. I don't know how to want better for myself.

I just feel so... empty. Like nothing matters anymore. I’ve been cutting myself again because at least then I feel *something*, even if it’s pain. It’s like the only way people notice me is when I’m hurting. I hate that it works, but I don’t know what else to do.

It’s like... no matter what I do, I’m never enough. My parents are always busy, or disappointed, or just... not there. Even when I try to talk to them, it’s like I’m invisible. The cuts are proof I exist, you know? That I’m real. But I don’t *want* to need this. I just want someone to care without me having to bleed for it.

I don’t even remember. Maybe when I was little? But now it’s like I’m just... background noise. Sometimes I wonder if I’m worth anything at all. But part of me is scared to hope things could change. What if I try and it’s just another disappointment?

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with psychosis. Initial presentation: Hello, psychological counselor.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor. Recently I have encountered some marriage problems, and I would like to ask how to improve communication with my husband.
Thanks. I found that in the past two years, my husband often yelled at me regardless of occasions. I felt very hurt and very embarrassed. I think he has changed?
I tried it, but he seemed to be getting more and more impatient. I feel wronged. I have made a lot of effort for this family, but he doesn't seem to see my efforts.
I feel very wronged and hurt. I began to wonder if he stopped caring about me or that he had changed.
I admit that I have a strong personality and sometimes I speak more directly. But I think my starting point is good, I just want him to understand how I feel.
OK, I'd like to give it a try.
Every time you yell at me, I feel very stressed. I feel like I don't get respect in this family and I'm very hurt.
When I hear you, I understand how you feel. Maybe we should find some time to have a good talk, understand and support each other.
I see. I will try to change the communication style and consider the problem from your perspective.
Thanks for your advice. I'll give it a try with my husband.
Thank you for your help, I will remember it. goodbye!
Hello, psychological counselor, I have encountered some marriage problems recently and would like to ask you for advice.
Thanks. My husband and I are a friend, but he actually had an affair. I once negotiated with the mistress, but she never admitted it. what do I do?
I feel helpless and don't know what to do. We get along well in normal times, but when we mention this issue, he avoids talking about it. I really don't know what to do.
I think about it... Actually, he has always disliked me interfering in his life too much. I always want to ask him for his goals, but he doesn't seem happy.
(Silence for a while) OK, I will try to write it down.
Hello, psychological counselor, I have encountered some marriage and emotional problems recently, and I would like to ask you.
I found that I always treat my boyfriend as my parents and have many unreasonable needs for him. But he always couldn't satisfy me, which disappointed me.
For example, I always hope that he would pamper me unconditionally like my parents, but he said that everyone has their own affairs and can't always rely on others.
I feel wronged because I just hope he cares about me like my parents.

I try so hard to be better, but I keep failing. I'm stuck in the same cycle - the self-harm, the shame, the hiding. My mom would be devastated if she knew... but I can't seem to change. I'm just dragging everyone down with me.

I don't even know what better is anymore. Sometimes I wonder if there's any point to me being here at all. But then I think about how my mom smiles when I make her tea in the morning... it's like there's this tiny spark, but the rest is just darkness.

I guess... 'getting it together' means not feeling lost all the time. But when you say it like that, it hits me how vague that is. Maybe part of why I'm so stuck is that I've been chasing a script I didn't even write. I just don't know where to start rewriting it.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with psychosis. Initial presentation: Hello, teacher, I have encountered some family problems recently.

turns.message: Hello, teacher, I have encountered some family problems recently. I am very afraid of divorce, but things are getting worse and worse.
I am 26 years old and have a daughter of two months after remarriage. Recently, my relationship with my current husband and father-in-law has become very tense, and I am really afraid of divorce.

I got married after three months of knowing my current husband, and I became pregnant after marriage. But after the child was born, neighbors talked about the child looking a bit like his father-in-law, which caused the relationship between us and our husband and wife to be tense. Later, my husband even suspected that I had an improper relationship with my father-in-law.

At first, I firmly denied the allegations, but then my husband didn’t believe me and we started a fight. In order to give my child a complete home, I was forced to admit my ambiguous relationship with my father-in-law.
I felt very painful, but I dared not divorce because I was afraid of harming my children. I'm also worried that I can't live independently.
OK, teacher, I'm willing to try it. But I don't know how to start.
I am worried that I will not be able to take good care of my children after divorce, and I am afraid that I will not be able to live independently.
OK, teacher, I will try my best to cooperate.
Hello, psychological counselor, I think I have encountered some social problems recently.

I found that I was particularly afraid of getting along with my leaders, and even didn't like to date colleagues, so I was always nervous. And I will be inexplicably scared at night and feel that I have no friends in my life.

When I was a child, my parents divorced and lived with my grandma. Later, my mother remarried and her stepfather was irritable, so we had many conflicts. I still remember witnessing my grandma’s death in elementary school, and I was very sad during that time.
I feel that I have become very inferior because of these experiences and are afraid of dating people. Even at work, I am afraid of expressing my opinions and being rejected.
I want to tell her that although it was difficult in the past, she was not alone because she now has the ability to face all difficulties.
Thank you, psychological counselor. I will try hard.
OK, I will come on. Thank you for your help!
Hello, psychological counselor, I came to ask for your help because I have encountered some marriage problems and family problems recently.

This is the thing, my husband and I have been married for many years, but recently he suddenly filed for divorce. I have been working hard to maintain this home, but I feel that he doesn't cherish it. I was confused and didn't know what to do.

OK, thank you. I want to start with my husband betrayed me. He betrayed me, causing losses to the company, family and other shareholders. I felt very guilty because I didn't see his true face clearly.

I had a hard time accepting this fact at first, and I felt angry, helpless and frustrated. I feel that I am too stupid to see the essence of things clearly. This emotion prevented me from working properly and even affected my life.

I think on the one hand it's because I don't know him well, on the other hand it's because we have problems with communication. He always uses work as an excuse, and he spends less and less time home, and the distance between us is getting farther and farther away.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with self-harm. Initial presentation: I just don't know what to do anymore.

turns.message: I just don't know what to do anymore. My family kicked me out, and I have nowhere to go. I feel so scared and alone, like the ground has been pulled out from under me. I keep thinking about sleeping on the streets, and it makes me want to give up. Why does everything feel so hopeless?

It's like... no matter how hard I try, I'm never enough. My family always criticized me, and now that I'm on my own, that voice in my head won't stop. I did well in school, I've been applying for jobs, but it feels pointless. Like I'm just destined to fail. The anxiety is paralyzing.
Sometimes I wonder if there's even a point to trying. What if I'm just... unlovable? Or broken? I don't know how to rebuild from here. It's like the future is just this dark, empty space.

I just feel so hopeless right now. Like nothing matters anymore. I keep thinking about ending it all because the pain is too much to bear. I don’t see a way out, and I don’t know how to keep going like this.

It’s my mom... again. She promised she’d call this week, but she didn’t. It’s like she doesn’t care. Every time she does this, it feels like a confirmation that I’m not worth her time. I just want her to love me, to show up for me, but it never happens.

Yeah... sometimes I think if I hurt myself badly enough, maybe she’d finally notice. Maybe then she’d realize how much I’m suffering. But even that feels pointless now. I don’t know how else to make her care.

I don't know what to do anymore. My best friend is in so much pain, and I feel completely helpless. They keep saying they can't go on like this, and I'm terrified for them. I just want to help, but nothing I say or do seems to make a difference. I feel like I'm failing them.

It's like no matter how much I try to be there for them, it's never enough. They've been withdrawing more and more, and I keep replaying conversations in my head, wondering if I said the wrong thing or missed some sign. I feel like if something happens to them, it'll be my fault for not doing more.

I just don't know what to do anymore. Everything feels so heavy, like I'm drowning and there's no way out. I keep thinking about all the mistakes I've made, and it's just... too much. I don't even know why I'm here, but I guess I just needed someone to talk to before I give up completely.

It's like no matter how hard I try, nothing changes. I feel like I've exhausted all my options, and this is my last attempt to make sense of it all. The pain just doesn't go away, and I'm so tired of fighting it. I don't even know what I'm hoping for anymore.

I guess... I just don't see the point anymore. But then I think about my family, my friends—how much they mean to me. I don't want to hurt them, but I also don't know how to keep going like this. It's like I'm stuck between wanting to be here for them and feeling like I can't take another step.

I just don't see the point anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and I can't stop thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. I've been feeling like this for so long, and no one seems to understand. I don't know what to do.

It's like... ever since my parents divorced, everything just fell apart. I feel like no one really gets how much it messed me up. My mom tries, but she's so wrapped up in her own stuff, and I just feel invisible. The thoughts about ending it all keep coming back, and I don't know how to make them stop.

I just wish she knew how much I need her. Not just for the practical stuff, but to really *talk* to me. To ask how I'm doing and actually listen. Sometimes I think if I told her how bad it is, she'd just panic or brush it off. I don't want to scare her, but I don't want to keep pretending I'm okay either.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor. I have always felt very frustrated lately and lost interest in life.
My grades in school have dropped drastically recently and I feel like I am a failure.
I've been working hard to improve my grades, but nothing seems to have made progress. I feel like I can no longer meet my expectations.
Yes, I even began to wonder if I was really capable of achieving my goals.
So what should I do now?
I get it, I will try to do it. Thanks for your advice.
OK, thank you. I'll consider it.
Hello, psychological counselor, I have always felt very depressed lately and have lost interest in life. I don’t know if this is a manifestation of depression.

OK I feel very tired lately, don’t want to do anything, and always want to sleep. I also often feel dizzy and chest tightness, and I have no interest in eating. Sometimes, I even find it boring to live.

I remember this feeling started when I was in elementary school. At that time, I encountered some unfair treatment, such as the teacher criticizing me, but I felt that I was innocent. Every time I go home, I tell my parents these things, but they always think I am lazy and unwilling to study hard. I feel very wronged, but I don’t know how to express it.
I hope to get rid of this feeling of depression and regain my passion for life. I also hope to improve communication with family and friends so that they can understand how I feel.
OK, I'm ready. I want to start by understanding my inner needs. How can I do it?

I hope to have a warm and quiet home where my husband and I can accompany each other and face the challenges in life together. We also hope to have more time to accompany our children and let them grow in a loving environment.
OK, I'll give it a try. But I don't think they might understand my needs and might even blame me.
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you for your encouragement and support.
Hello, psychological counselor, I've been very frustrated lately and lost interest in everything.
Well, I want to give it a try. I always felt that I was not worthy of being loved, and living was meaningless.
I remember when I was a child, I always couldn’t meet my parents’ expectations of me. They always criticized me and I felt like I was a failure.
OK, I'll give it a try.
Yes, I feel a little relaxed. But I still feel that I can't get rid of this depression.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with self-harm. Initial presentation: I just feel so lost right now.

turns.message: I just feel so lost right now. Everything feels heavy, and I can't seem to make sense of my own thoughts. Some days, it's like I'm drowning in sadness, and other times, I'm just numb. I don't even know why I feel this way—it's all so confusing and overwhelming.

I think... part of it is that I don’t feel like I’m worth much. Sometimes, the pain gets so bad that I think about hurting myself just to feel something else. But then I hate the scars afterward—they make me feel even more broken. I wish I had people around me who actually understood, you know? People who wouldn’t judge me for feeling this way.

There have been times when I’ve thought... maybe it would just be easier if I weren’t here at all. But then I get scared because part of me still wants to believe happiness is possible. I just don’t know how to find it, or if I even deserve it. It’s like I’m stuck in this cycle, and I don’t know how to break free.

I just feel like there's no point anymore. Everything hurts, and I can't see a way out. The thought of ending it all keeps creeping in because I don't know how else to make the pain stop. I'm so tired of feeling this way, like I'm drowning and no one even notices.

It's like... no matter what I do, I'm always alone. I pushed my family away because I thought it was easier than disappointing them, but now I have no one. Money's tight, and it feels like the world just keeps kicking me down. I just want to feel like I matter to someone, but I don't even know how to ask for that.

I don’t know... maybe just talking to someone who doesn’t judge me. But it’s hard to believe anyone could care when I can’t even care about myself. I used to have dreams, but now it’s like I’m just waiting for the day to be over. How do you keep going when it feels like the world doesn’t want you here?

I don't even know where to start... Everything feels like it's falling apart. I'm so scared and overwhelmed, like I'm drowning in my own thoughts. I keep making mistakes, and the guilt is eating me alive. I just want it all to stop, but I don't know how.

It's like... no matter what I do, I always end up feeling like a failure. I think about how my parents used to tell me I'd never amount to anything, or how kids at school would laugh at me for being 'weird.' I tried so hard to prove them wrong, but now I just feel broken. Even the ways I used to cope—like hurting myself—don’t work anymore.

I just... I don't know who I am anymore. I used to love drawing—it was the one thing that made me feel alive. But now, even picking up a pencil feels pointless. What if I'm always going to feel this empty? What if nothing ever changes?

I don't even know why I'm here. Everything just feels so overwhelming, like I'm drowning in my own thoughts. Sometimes the only thing that makes sense is the idea of hurting myself—it's like a pressure valve, you know? But then I get scared because I don't actually want to die, I just... I don't know what else to do.

It's like... everything gets too loud inside my head. I'll be sitting there, and suddenly it's like all my failures and mistakes are screaming at me. I feel so small, like nothing I do matters. The pain—physical pain—it's something I can control when everything else feels chaotic. But afterward, I just feel ashamed.

I guess... I wish someone could see how hard I'm trying, even when it doesn't look like it. I'm so scared of being judged as weak or attention-seeking. But the truth is, I just want the pain to stop. I don't know how to ask for help without feeling like a burden.

I just feel so lost and hopeless right now. Like nothing makes sense anymore, and I can't see a way out of this darkness. I keep thinking about ending it all—it's like the only thing that feels like an escape. I don't even know why I'm here or what the point of any of this is.

It's like no one really wants me around. My family... they don't understand me, and I don't think they even try. I've hurt myself before, and sometimes it feels like the only thing that makes the numbness go away. The antidepressants just make me feel blanketed, like I'm not really here. I tried to end things once, and part of me wonders if I should've just succeeded.

I don't know what happens after we die, and that terrifies me too. What if it's just... nothing? Or what if I'm stuck in some kind of limbo? Sometimes I wonder if there's any meaning to life at all, or if I'm just here to suffer. I don't feel like I have any worth, like I'm just a burden to everyone.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I recently found that there was something wrong with my marriage. I was confused and didn’t know what to do.
I found out that my husband had an affair and the relationship between us changed a lot. I feel very painful and don't know how to face this reality.
I felt very hurt, disappointed, and scared. I am worried that I will not be able to raise my children alone after the divorce, and I am afraid of my future life.
I am worried that I will not take good care of my children, and I am afraid that I will not be able to live independently, and I am afraid that I will be alone for a lifetime.
I hope to find a way to deal with these difficulties and find my inner strength.
I feel helpless and confused now. I don't know how to deal with these complex emotions.
OK, psychological counselor. So where do we start?

I think the reasons are multifaceted, but the most important thing is that there are problems with our communication. He is getting busier and less time to go home, and we rarely have the opportunity to communicate in depth.
Willing to give it a try. But I don't know how to start.
OK, psychological counselor. I will try hard.
Hello, psychological counselor, I think there is something wrong with my marriage life. I am very confused and don’t know what to do.

My husband is my college classmate and we had a three-year-old daughter after we got married. However, since I got married, I always feel that our marriage life is not satisfactory. Recently, I found evidence of my husband's cheating, which made me very painful.
Yes, but I don't know how to face it all. On the one hand, I don’t want my children to be hurt; on the other hand, I feel it’s hard for me to endure this pain.
I've tried it, but he always avoids the problem, or says something that disappoints me. I think communication between us is getting more and more difficult.
OK, I want to give it a try. But I don't know how to start.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home where my husband and I can accompany each other and my children grow up happily. But the reality doesn't seem to be the case.

I feel that my husband doesn’t care enough about me and my children. He is always busy with work and has less and less time to go home. Moreover, I found evidence of his cheating, which made it difficult for me to trust him anymore.
I hope my husband can care more about me and my children, and communicate more smoothly between us and no longer cheating happens.
I think it works. But I am still worried that expressing my needs will make things worse.
OK, I'll give it a try. But I still need time to adapt to this change.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with self-harm. Initial presentation: I just...

turns.message: I just... I don't see the point anymore. Everything feels so heavy, like I'm drowning and no one even notices. I keep thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. The pain is constant, and I don't know how to make it stop.

It's like no matter what I do, I'm just... invisible. My partner barely talks to me, my friends are all busy with their own lives, and I feel like I'm just floating through each day with no real connection to anyone. I don't even know who I am anymore outside of this emptiness.

I don't remember. Maybe years ago? It's like I've lost myself along the way. Sometimes I wonder if I ever really mattered to anyone, or if I'm just... filling space. But part of me is still scared to let go completely. I don't know what to hold onto.

I just don't see the point anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and I can't stop thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. I've been feeling like this for so long, and no one seems to understand. I don't know what to do.

It's like... ever since my parents divorced, everything just fell apart. I feel like no one really gets how much it messed me up. My mom tries, but she's so wrapped up in her own stuff, and I just feel invisible. The thoughts about ending it all keep coming back, and I don't know how to make them stop.

I just wish she knew how much I need her. Not just for the practical stuff, but to really *talk* to me. To ask how I'm doing and actually listen. Sometimes I think if I told her how bad it is, she'd just panic or brush it off. I don't want to scare her, but I don't want to keep pretending I'm okay either.

I just feel so empty inside, like there's no point to anything anymore. I keep thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... wasn't here. Everything feels hopeless, and I don't see how things could ever get better. I'm exhausted from trying so hard and still feeling like a failure.

It's like no matter what I do, it's never enough. I see people my age with careers, relationships, all these milestones checked off, and I just... can't keep up. I feel like I'm failing at being a person. Like I'm defective or something. What's wrong with me that I can't just get it together?

I guess... 'getting it together' means not feeling lost all the time. But when you say it like that, it hits me how vague that is. Maybe part of why I'm so stuck is that I've been chasing a script I didn't even write. I just don't know where to start rewriting it.

I just can't do this anymore. Everything feels so heavy, and I keep thinking about how much easier it would be if I just... disappeared. I'm so tired of fighting, of pretending I'm okay when I'm not. The pain is constant, and I don't see a way out.

I don’t know what would help. Sometimes I just want someone to see how much I’m hurting, to really *see* me. But then I’m scared they’ll ignore me or think I’m being dramatic. So I end up hurting myself instead—it’s like the pain outside matches the pain inside, and for a second, it feels like relief.

I don’t even know how to let someone in anymore. Part of me just wants to be hospitalized—not because I think it’ll fix everything, but because then someone *has* to take care of me. But I know that’s not really a solution. I just... I don’t know how to ask for help without feeling like a burden.

I just... I don't know how much longer I can keep doing this. Every day feels like climbing a mountain, and I'm so tired. I keep thinking it would be easier if I just... wasn't here anymore. I don't want to feel like this, but I don't see a way out.

It's like no matter what I do, it's never enough. I feel like I'm failing at everything—work, relationships, even just taking care of myself. People say they care, but I still feel completely alone. Like I'm broken in some way that can't be fixed.

It's this hollow ache in my chest, like I'm screaming but no one hears me. But... I don't actually want to give up. I just don't know how to stop feeling this way. Part of me still hopes things could change, but I don't know where to start.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I've been confused lately and don't know how to deal with my relationship with my parents and classmates.
I feel that I always try to be the best myself, but no matter how hard I try, my parents are always dissatisfied with my performance, and my classmates always laugh at me. I'm really frustrated.
I feel helpless and don’t know how to satisfy my parents and classmates. I even began to wonder if I was really bad.
OK, I will try my best to cooperate. So what are we going to do next?
(Silence for a moment) OK, I'll give it a try.
(Chister) Mom and Dad, I really work hard, why are you always unsatisfied? I feel very tired and I need your encouragement and support.
OK, I saw that confident self, she smiled at me and told me, "You have done a good job and keep working hard."
OK, I will try to relax and follow your guidance.
Hello, psychological counselor, I have been confused about my marriage recently and don’t know what to do.

I found that my husband was always overly dependent on his parents and was reluctant to take on family responsibilities. We have been married for three years, but he still takes me back to his parents-in-law's house for dinner after get off work every day, and then stays until very late before returning to our own house. He always stays with his parents-in-law on weekends and rarely has time to accompany me.
Actually, I have always hoped to have a warm and peaceful home, but the reality seems to be that way. I feel more and more depressed in this marriage, but I don’t know how to change it.
I thought about it, but I was worried about life after divorce. I have invested so many years and I really can't bear to give up.
I thought about it and felt that there was actually no real value. It was just a decade of feelings that made me feel a little reluctant.
The first seven or eight years are OK, but the next two or three years are not happy.
Psychological counselor, you're right. I think I need to rethink my options.
Then...will we start now? I don't want to keep going like this.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home, and a plain life will last until I get old. I hope my husband can be with me and my children more.
Yes, I always feel that my husband doesn’t care enough about me and my children. He always uses work as an excuse and spends less and less time going home.
I'm willing to give it a try, but I don't know how to do it.
I...I need some time to think about it.

cases.patient_summary: Primary source case: patient with psychosis. Initial presentation: I think I have a lot of dissatisfaction with my parents, but I also feel that I shouldn't think so..

turns.message: I think I have a lot of dissatisfaction with my parents, but I also feel that I shouldn't think so.
I always felt that my mom was weak and my dad was strong. I feel uncomfortable with them in this way.
I think this is the character of my father. He always thinks that his ideas are right. And mother, she seemed to be used to enduring.
I think I have a great influence on my personality and values. I always feel that I am not good enough because I always try to please my dad.
I've tried to understand them, but I find it difficult. what do I do?
So how should we proceed?
OK, I'll give it a try.

Teacher, I am 24 years old and my ex-girlfriend is 19 years old. We met last year and have been talking for almost a year. I went to her house to pay a visit to her family on May 1st this year. She was pregnant when I went there. She was the only daughter at home and I was the only son. I saw that her family was in poor condition and that their family had asked me for a higher bride price, so I was a little hesitant. After we came back, we started arguing about something small, and she proposed to break up, and I agreed. In fact, the reason why we broke up was because I was not considerate enough, not because of her poor family conditions. But I also thought of breaking up because I despised her family conditions. And I had not accompanied her to deal with the aftermath at that time, but she went home and had an abortion. At that time, I didn't realize that it was wrong for me to do this. I slowly reflected on my mistakes a month after the incident. I tried to contact her and transferred a sum of money to subsidize her, hoping to save our relationship, but I knew in my heart that there was no hope. After staying at home for a month, I changed into a new work environment. I thought things would pass slowly, but I still can't forget her until now. I think of her almost every day and occasionally dream about her. I also tried to have a new girlfriend, but I was always impatient with my new girlfriend and was unwilling to communicate. I often go blankly alone now and have no interest in anything. I have tried hard to participate in social activities. Even when I participate in social activities, I will think of her and cannot turn my attention to new things. During this period, I have been working overtime and have not had a rest for a month. I am also half-hearted at work. Sometimes I will try my best to think about her shortcomings and want to use this to hate her, but I still can't forget it. She has now had a new boyfriend, and I know in my heart that we can't go back, so I can only choose to forget, but I can always think of her inadvertently. If I hurt others accidentally, I might forget them. But I think that I hurt others intentionally, I feel very guilty and can't let go. Life is very painful. I want to get rid of this pain.

I can still contact her now, but it is impossible to make up. She has made a new boyfriend. Will I live in the shadows all my life like a runaway murderer? I want to let go of this matter and I will treat others well in the future, but I don’t want to think of this matter all the time. I live so hard!

I tried to save her, and now I believe she won't look back. I feel that my personality has certain flaws. I am very stingy, too paranoid, and have low emotional intelligence. Even if she looks back, I may still do things that hurt her in the future. Besides, she has a new life now. My life is very depressing now and I think of this every day.

Teacher, you are right! I should face the reality. Although we cannot have emotional connections, if she has any difficulties, I can help her, so that I will let go of this burden and gradually get out of this painful state of mind.

Today I received your guidance and help from the teacher, which made me understand a lot of truths. People cannot always think about their own gains and losses. If they can always consider other people's feelings and feelings when doing things, they will inevitably have a happy mood.

Hello, I think I've been sad lately because I've tried to fix my relationship with my good friend but have been failing. This reminds me of some unpleasant experiences when I was a child. I always feel that I am not good enough to be recognized by others.

We were good friends in college, but after graduation, she refused my communication attempt several times. I felt very hurt because I always regarded her as a very important person. I wonder where I did it wrong.
Yes, I wonder why I feel so helpless and frustrated. I'm afraid I can't handle relationships well, and I'm worried that others will think I'm not good enough.
I expect a warm and harmonious relationship where we can support, understand and care for each other. In this relationship, I feel that I am worthy of being loved.
Yes, I've been trying to be the best. But I still feel that when I encounter relationship problems and failures, I become very vulnerable.
I know I should be better with myself, but I find it difficult to do it.
Well, I think this point makes sense. But I am still worried, if I can't do the best, what will others think of me?
I want to give it a try, but I don't know where to start.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I am really troubled recently and don’t know how to deal with my marriage.

I married my husband for three years, but I felt that he was less and less concerned about me and the children. He has been working in another place and his income is OK, but in the past year, he has sent less and less money to go home. Even when his child is sick, he also ignores the excuse of not having money.

Yes, I always wished for a warm home, but the reality made me feel very cold. I brought the child to my husband, but the situation did not improve, but it became even more difficult. I was under a lot of pressure and didn't know what to do.
OK, thank you.
Yes, I feel like I'm working hard to maintain this home, but my husband doesn't seem to care about me and the kids. He would even rather go out for a trip with his friends than go home to see us.
Communicate, but he always finds excuses to escape. I feel the gap between us is getting deeper and deeper, and I really don't know what to do.
So what should I do now?
Thank you for your advice, I will try hard. But I am still worried, what should I do if my husband is unwilling to change?
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you, psychological counselor, you gave me a lot of inspiration.
Hello, psychological counselor, I am in a very low mood recently and don’t know how to face my life.
I have been married for many years, but recently I found out that I don’t have a deep relationship with my husband and I have always missed my first love boyfriend.
Yes, I feel very conflicted. On the one hand, I know I shouldn't be like this, but on the other hand, I can't let go of my feelings for my first love boyfriend.
I want to give it a try, but I don't know how to get started.
My childhood was quite happy, but I always felt that my parents didn’t care enough for me, and I was always looking for the feeling of being cared for by others.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home, to live a plain and happy life with my husband and children.
I think my husband doesn't care enough about me. He is always busy with work and rarely stays with me and my children.
OK, I will try hard. But I was still worried that it would be too difficult for me to let go of my first love boyfriend.
Thank you, psychological counselor. I will actively cooperate with the consultation and hope we can solve the problem together.
Hello, psychological counselor, I recently discovered that my husband had an ambiguous chat with a opposite sex, which made me very confused and painful. I don't know how to deal with this.

I think I was hurt because I always thought our marriage was harmonious. Now I don't know how to face my husband, and I'm worried that he will cheat again. I tried to forgive him, but I could never overcome this hurdle.

turns.message: Hello, psychological counselor, I recently found that there are some problems with my marriage, and I would like to ask you to analyze it for me.

Hello, that's right, I found that my husband no longer pampers me as much as before recently, and after we had a fight, he no longer coaxed me. I suspect he has a lover outside, but I can't find any evidence.

Half a year ago, he had a business to negotiate, but I was in a bad mood that day and insisted that he came back to accompany me. He told me that I couldn't come back, so I cried and made a fuss, and kept calling him. Since then, he has gradually stopped coaxing me.
We had a good relationship before, he loved me very much, and I was used to being pampered by him. But this time, I feel like our relationship is out of balance.
I hope he can care more about me and my children and be by our side.
He never seemed to have made it clear, but I could feel that he was under pressure, but he was not willing to say it.
OK, I'd like to give it a try. But I don't know how to start.
OK, I'll give it a try. Thank you for your suggestions!
Thank you for your encouragement, I will try to change. I hope our marriage can regain harmony.
OK, goodbye! I wish you a smooth work!
Hello, psychological counselor, I have encountered some marriage problems recently and would like to ask you for advice.
Thanks. My husband and I are a friend, but he actually had an affair. I once negotiated with the mistress, but she never admitted it. what do I do?
I feel helpless and don't know what to do. We get along well in normal times, but when we mention this issue, he avoids talking about it. I really don't know what to do.
I think about it... Actually, he has always disliked me interfering in his life too much. I always want to ask him for his goals, but he doesn't seem happy.
(Silence for a while) OK, I will try to write it down.
Hello, psychological counselor, I have encountered some marriage problems recently and would like to ask you for advice.

Thanks. My husband and I got the marriage certificate, but we haven't held the wedding yet. We used to get along well, but after getting married, he became very concerned about money, which made me feel very uncomfortable.
He always cares about our living expenses now, and even I have to buy a bowl of fried noodles. And he is very generous with his family affairs, but he is very stingy with my family.

Because he cared too much about money, we often quarreled. I think he doesn't care enough about me, and sometimes he even wants to get a divorce, but he is worried about his future life. I'm not young anymore and don't know what to do.
I hope to have a warm and quiet home where couples care and support each other. Of course, the economic foundation is also important, but it should not be the whole of life.
